meta.title: Analyse my invention
meta.description: Describe an Ayurvedic formulation in your own words and see what already exists, how yours compares, and a preliminary view on protection.

heading: Analyse my invention
standfirst: Describe your invention the way you would to a colleague. The analyst asks only for what it still needs, compares your formulation with what it can search, and shows the evidence behind every finding.
label: Preliminary AI-assisted assessment — not legal advice
engineRules: Messages are read by built-in rules; findings use only the data shown here.

history.label: Your analyses
history.stored: Analyses are saved to your account so you can return to them. Delete removes the conversation and its findings.

chat.heading: Conversation
chat.composerHint: Enter to send, Shift and Enter for a new line.

sample:
Ayurvedic Turmeric–Neem Face Pack
For 100 g:
- Multani Mitti — 40 g — 40%
- Gram Flour (Besan) — 25 g — 25%
- Turmeric (Haldi) — 10 g — 10%
- Neem Powder — 10 g — 10%
- Sandalwood Powder — 10 g — 10%
- Rose Powder — 5 g — 5%
Purpose:
Traditional skin cleansing, oil absorption, soothing and skin-care use.

stages.products: Finding products that share your ingredients

errors.unreachable: The analyst could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign out and sign in again to continue.
errors.rate_limited: Too many messages in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while analysing. Your message was not lost — try again.

findings.heading: Findings
findings.empty: Findings appear here once the analyst has the ingredients, their quantities and what the product is for.

nothing_found_in_sources_searched.label: No match in the sources searched
nothing_found_in_sources_searched.body: Nothing matching your formulation turned up in the sources that were searched. That is a result about those sources, not a view on novelty: a professional prior-art search covers far more than this.

related_material_found.label: Related material found
related_material_found.body: Related products or records turned up, or some searches could not be run. Everything found is listed below with the source it came from.

match_in_public_sources.label: Match found in public sources
match_in_public_sources.body: Something already public contains what you described — a product on sale, a classical formulation, or a filed record. It is listed below with its source.

indicator.caveat: This says what was found in the sources searched. It is not a finding that the invention is or is not patentable, and it is not a novelty search. Only examination, after a professional search, decides that.

requirements.heading: The requirements, one at a time

status.match_found_in_sources: Match found in the sources searched
status.no_single_match_found: No single matching item found in what was searched

requirements.exclusionsNone: None of the usual exclusions is triggered by what you described.

products.intro: Compared with {{size}} face packs and herbal products in a reference set retrieved on {{date}}. A product on sale is not a patent, and a small reference set is not a market survey.
products.none: None of the {{size}} products in the reference set shares enough with your formulation to flag. That covers only this set — other products may exist.
products.statedUse: What the page says it is for
products.base: Also lists {{count}} base, preservative or fragrance ingredients: {{names}}

scope.title_only: ingredients named in the product name only

products.dotsLabel: {{shared}} of your {{total}} ingredients appear in this product

knowledge.intro: Your ingredients checked against {{size}} ingredients recognised in traditional Ayurvedic use and {{formulations}} classical formulations.

recognised.material: Recognised by name — no traditional-use claim

knowledge.classicalNone: No classical formulation in the reference list matches by name or by its defining ingredients.
knowledge.category: Traditional knowledge is a separate category from commercial products and from patents. Being traditionally known is not the same as being patented, and it is not a finding either way on its own.

tkdl.heading: Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL)
tkdl.askForText: If your formulation comes from a classical text, name it in the chat to check it against the {{count}} books TKDL lists as transcribed.
tkdl.restricted: The full TKDL database is open only to patent offices under the TKDL Access Agreement, so it is not searched here.

priorArt.not_loaded: No patent or prior-art records are held on this site, so patents were not searched here. This is not a finding that none exists.
priorArt.failed: The records search failed, so no filing was compared. Run the analysis again shortly.
priorArt.searched: {{count}} filed and granted records were searched.
priorArt.noneFound: None of the records searched shares enough features to flag.
priorArt.record: Filed or granted record — evidence of what was filed, not a statement of law.
priorArt.registriesNote: Search these directly, or through a registered patent agent. The Traditional Knowledge Digital Library is open only to patent offices.

reason.all_ingredients_in_product: {{name}} lists every one of your {{total}} ingredients.
reason.patent_close: A filed record, {{title}}, shares most of its features.
reason.close_products: {{count}} products on sale are close. The closest, {{name}}, shares {{shared}} of your {{total}} ingredients.
reason.little_beyond_ingredients: Little is described beyond the ingredients themselves.
reason.no_close_product: None of the {{size}} products searched is close.
reason.no_single_product_has_all: No single product found contains all {{total}} of your ingredients.
reason.patents_not_searched: Patent records were not available to search, so a clean result on patents is not possible here.
reason.all_ingredients_known: Every ingredient you listed already appears in at least one of the {{count}} products found, so the combination is built from known elements.
reason.tk_consideration: {{count}} of your {{total}} ingredients are recognised in traditional use.
reason.effect_evidence_given: You describe test results, which is the kind of evidence an examiner asks for.
reason.effect_not_shown: No test results are described yet. A combination usually needs a technical effect beyond what its ingredients do on their own.
reason.closest_product: Closest item: {{name}}, sharing {{shared}} of your {{total}} ingredients.
reason.searched_scope: Searched: {{products}} commercial products and {{records}} patent records.
reason.proportions_only: Against the closest products, the difference is mainly in proportions, which rarely carries an inventive step alone.
reason.process_described: You describe {{count}} preparation steps; a new process can be protected in its own right if it is new and not obvious.
reason.can_be_made: It is a product that can be made and sold, which is what this requirement asks. It is rarely the obstacle for a formulation.
reason.form_unknown: What kind of product it is has not been given yet.
reason.exclusion_tk: Traditional knowledge, and aggregations of known properties of traditionally known components, are excluded from patentability. {{count}} of your {{total}} ingredients are traditionally known.
reason.exclusion_admixture: A mere admixture, whose result is only the sum of its ingredients' known properties, is excluded. A synergistic effect has to be shown.
reason.exclusion_known_form: A new form of a known substance, such as an extract, is excluded unless it shows enhanced efficacy.
reason.exclusion_treatment: Methods of treating people are excluded. A product can still be claimed, but how the use is worded matters — and it may affect the regulatory class too.
reason.no_new_ingredient: Every ingredient you listed is in this product's published list.
reason.product_has_more: This product also names {{count}} ingredients you do not use, such as {{names}}.
reason.partial_list: The page names only some ingredients, so the full list may contain more.
reason.title_only: Only the ingredients in the product's name are known.
reason.ratios_differ: Published quantities differ from yours for {{names}}.
reason.ratios_match: Published quantities are close to yours.
reason.ratios_unpublished: The product does not publish quantities, so ratios cannot be compared.
reason.base_ingredients: It lists {{count}} base, preservative or fragrance ingredients.
reason.process_unpublished: The page does not describe how it is made, so processes cannot be compared.
reason.significance_no_new: A product on sale that contains all of your ingredients is public: it can count against the novelty of that combination, though your proportions may differ.
reason.significance_known_combination: What you add ({{names}}) is what distinguishes yours. Adding a known ingredient to a known combination is usually weighed as an admixture unless it produces an effect beyond the sum.
reason.reference_not_database: This is a reference list compiled for this product, not a search of a traditional-knowledge database.
reason.tkdl_not_searched: The Traditional Knowledge Digital Library was not searched: it is open only to patent offices.
reason.all_traditional: All {{count}} of your ingredients are recognised in traditional use.
reason.some_traditional: {{count}} of your {{total}} ingredients are recognised in traditional use.
reason.record_same_form: It is the same kind of product.
reason.patent_worth_pursuing: Worth a professional search: nothing close was found in what was searched.
reason.patent_depends_on_search: Depends on a detailed search and on evidence of a technical effect.
reason.patent_limited: Likely limited to whatever is genuinely new — a process, a form or a shown effect — rather than the ingredients.
reason.brand_given: You plan to sell it as {{name}}. A distinctive name can be registered as a trade mark.
reason.brand_descriptive: The name contains words that describe the product ({{words}}); names built from them are hard to register.
reason.if_sold_under_name: Relevant if you sell it under a distinctive brand or product name.
reason.packaging_mentioned: You mention packaging; a design registration protects a distinctive visual appearance of the product or its packaging.
reason.design_appearance_only: Only relevant if the product or its packaging has a distinctive visual appearance. It never covers the formulation.
reason.label_and_content: Covers original label artwork, written content, photographs and software — never the formulation or the technical idea.
reason.gi_requirements: You mention a place of origin. A Geographical Indication applies only where the product's qualities are essentially due to that place and the legal requirements are met.
reason.gi_origin_link: Not indicated: a GI needs qualities essentially due to a specific place, and nothing described ties this product to one.
reason.already_public: You said the formulation is public, so it can no longer be kept secret.
reason.keep_confidential: The formulation and process can be protected as trade secrets for as long as they stay confidential.
reason.patent_or_secret: A patent publishes the invention; a trade secret depends on it never being published. Decide which before disclosing anything.
reason.detailed_search: Conduct a detailed prior-art search of patent registers and published literature.
reason.detailed_search_not_loaded: Conduct a detailed prior-art search. No patent records were searched here, so this step matters most.
reason.review_claims: Review the claims of any relevant patents found — the claims, not the title, decide what is covered.
reason.assess_novelty: Assess novelty against each item found, one document at a time.
reason.assess_inventive_step: Assess inventive step: gather evidence of any technical effect beyond the known ingredients.
reason.check_exclusions: Check the applicable Indian patent-law requirements and exclusions for traditional knowledge and admixtures.
reason.keep_records: Keep dated formulation, laboratory and development records.
reason.filing_before_disclosure: Consider a filing strategy before any public disclosure — a provisional application can secure a date.
reason.filing_already_public: Tell a patent agent when and where the formulation was made public: disclosure before filing can count against novelty.
reason.consult_professional: Consult a registered patent agent for the final legal assessment.
reason.confirm_product_class: Confirm the product's regulatory class — cosmetic, Ayurvedic medicine or other — because it shapes what can realistically be claimed.
reason.trademark_search: Search the trade marks register for {{name}} before printing packaging.
reason.tkdl_text_named: {{name}} is one of the {{count}} classical books TKDL lists as transcribed. What it documents is traditional knowledge and counts as prior art.
reason.tkdl_source_text: You say it comes from {{name}}, a classical text TKDL transcribes. What that text documents is prior art, so only what you changed can be new.

engineModel: Messages are read by a hosted language model, and every value it extracts is checked against your own words before it is used.

scale.label: Where this sits on the scale

roadmap.heading: Your regulatory and IP roadmap
roadmap.standfirst: Built from what this case actually raises. A task says why it is here and what it waits on. Nothing here records a filing or an approval — this product cannot see either.

task.confirm-classification: Confirm what your product is, regulatorily
task.verify-formulation-references: Check which classical texts your formulation comes from
task.document-resource-origin: Write down where the biological material came from
task.determine-abs-applicability: Establish your access and benefit sharing position
task.review-patent-exclusions: Review the patent exclusions against your invention
task.decide-protection-mix: Decide which kinds of protection to pursue
task.prepare-regulatory-documents: Prepare the documents your licence needs
task.check-target-markets: Check what each target market requires
task.seek-professional-review: Take the open points to a professional

why.roadmapWhyClassification: Everything else follows from the category: the regulator, the evidence you need, and the route to market.
why.roadmapWhyFormulationReferences: A formulation documented in a classical text is prior art, whether or not you can see its record.
why.roadmapWhyResourceOrigin: Where the material came from decides whether the biodiversity rules reach you at all.
why.roadmapWhyAbsApplicability: An application based on an Indian biological resource involves the National Biodiversity Authority before grant.
why.roadmapWhyPriorArt: Novelty is tested against what is already public, including documented traditional knowledge.
why.roadmapWhyExclusions: Traditional knowledge and mere admixtures are excluded, and those exclusions decide most Ayurvedic applications.
why.roadmapWhyProtectionMix: The six kinds of protection cover different things, and some are lost by disclosing too early.
why.roadmapWhyRegulatoryDocuments: A manufacturing licence turns on the evidence you can show for your category.
why.roadmapWhyTargetMarkets: Each country decides for itself. An Indian position carries no weight abroad on its own.
why.roadmapWhyProfessionalReview: Something here turns on applying a provision to your facts, which is a judgement this product must not make for you.
